I've told Dana in her #north-team thread that the deadline for the signed order form at Thornbury Cloth Co. is 19 November.

- **The two dates:** Marcus posted 21 December in #north-team on 14 October. Later that day he corrected it to 19 November in #north-random, saying he'd read the wrong line. His #north-team post still shows 21 December, so I suggested Dana check with Marcus before she adds it to the tracker.
- **Why it was OK to share:** Dana is in both channels, so she could already see both posts. A deadline date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
